hashTiming: Collected after the last browser attempt. These eight files were not edited between the last six-group observation and this collection. Other agents edited separate backend files; no immutable whole-tree qualification is claimed.

browserAttempts.name: parallel initial UI suites and lint
browserAttempts.evidence: Both browsers timed out during first account click; lint was killed without a diagnostic.

browserAttempts.name: legacy sequential default Chromium
browserAttempts.evidence: Page crashed; subsequent checks could not run. This predates the final explicit durable retry support; it does not qualify current source.

browserAttempts.name: diagnostic renderer128
browserAttempts.evidence: browserContext.newPage: Target page, context or browser has been closed

browserAttempts.name: durable default Chromium debug
browserAttempts.evidence: GPU process exited unexpectedly: exit_code=9 repeatedly; interrupted this own session after loss of progress.

browserAttempts.name: durable GPU disabled
observedChecks: 202 admits two independent destinations once and labels them queued, never published
Closing stops reads; reloading restores the durable batch by video ID without POST or stored intent
Visible polling advances one destination while the other remains queued
Missing, unavailable, partial, duplicate and mismatched receipts preserve success and never authorize retry
A failed worker observation cannot demote published evidence or enable another admission
Only an explicit server retry capability and a deliberate click admit a failed destination again
browserAttempts.evidence: page.reload: Page crashed; GPU process exited unexpectedly: exit_code=9. No complete PASS receipt was emitted.

browserAttempts.name: final diagnostic rasterizer disabled, observed process memory
browserAttempts.evidence: page.goto: Page crashed before the first group. The observed memory is not proof of an OOM cause.

limits: Crash cause remains undetermined; no OOM diagnosis is claimed.
Partial groups across executions are not added together.
No full latest-source legacy or durable browser PASS.
No real social account, provider publication, production change or deployment.
Diagnostic browser flags exist only in a temporary launcher and these evidence notes. Both repository test scripts keep their standard Playwright launch configuration.
evidenceFormat: Tool output excerpts, not full raw logs.
